title: SolvexGUI OP v1.2
features:
Note: The key system shown on the page cannot be used as is, since it requires a unique identifier. Please request key generation from the script menu to obtain a valid key.

Auto-Fish v2 - catches fish using server functions; works faster than the built-in auto-fish.

Auto-Fish v1 - catches fish very quickly by emulating player inputs.

Sell All - sells all fish when pressed.

Auto Sell - automatically sells all fish at specified time intervals.

Fishing Radar - shows fishing spots.

Teleport - teleports you to the selected island.

Oxygen Tank - equips an oxygen tank on the player.

Jesus - walk on water.

Movement - fly, speedhack, infinite jump, etc.
